I have been farming these 6 mu in Quzhou for 28 years. I finished middle school. I do not read books about farming, but I talk to the input dealer Lao Wang and I watch what my neighbors do. Last year my cabbage was good but the chili price dropped, so this year I keep the same areas because I cannot afford to guess wrong.

My 4 mu cabbage-chili plot is my main income. For spring cabbage, I rotary till first. I put 80 kg of 15-15-15 compound fertilizer per mu as base — that is one and a half bags. Then I top-dress twice with 15 kg urea each time. That comes to about 26 kg nitrogen, 12 kg phosphorus, and 12 kg potassium per mu. I irrigate 5 times and spray pesticide 4 times for cabbage worms and aphids. I plant hybrid cabbage seeds. If the weather is normal I expect 4500 kg per mu.

After I pull out the cabbage in June, I plant chili on the same 4 mu. I buy hybrid chili seedlings. I put 50 kg compound fertilizer as base, then top-dress twice with 12 kg urea each time, and I add 15 kg potassium sulfate because chili needs more potassium. That is about 18 kg nitrogen, 8 kg phosphorus, and 15 kg potassium per mu. I irrigate 7 times and spray 6 times — chili has many diseases and thrips. I expect 2500 kg per mu.

My eggplant is 1.5 mu. I use hybrid seeds. I put 50 kg compound fertilizer plus 20 kg potassium sulfate as base, then top-dress twice with 15 kg urea. That is about 21 kg nitrogen, 8 kg phosphorus, and 18 kg potassium per mu. Eggplant needs water, so I irrigate 6 times and spray 5 times for red spider mite. Expected yield is 3500 kg per mu.

I plant kidney bean on 0.5 mu because my family eats it and it sells fast at the market. I use improved seeds. I put 40 kg compound fertilizer as base and top-dress once with 5 kg urea. That is about 8 kg nitrogen, 6 kg phosphorus, and 6 kg potassium per mu. I irrigate 3 times and spray 3 times. Expected yield is 1200 kg per mu.

I figure the fertilizer cost for all 6 mu is about 2800 yuan. That is a lot, but in 2019 I tried to save 300 yuan on fertilizer and my cabbage heads were small. I lost much more than I saved. So I would rather put enough than risk it. My neighbor Zhang uses similar rates and his yields are steady. I do what works.
